question: I wanted to follow up on our previous conversation about front-end and back-end development. Can you remind me of the specific back-end programming languages you recommended I learn?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] Can you explain the difference between front-end and back-end web development?

[turn 2] Ah, I see. So a front-end developer makes things look pretty while the back-end developer makes sure everything works smoothly?

[turn 4] It sounds like front-end and back-end development require different skill sets. Can someone be proficient in both areas?

[turn 6] It seems like there's so much to learn in both front-end and back-end development. Do you have any tips for someone who wants to become a full-stack developer?

[turn 8] Do you recommend any specific resources or online courses for someone who wants to learn front-end and back-end development?
